description_en: Retrieves a list of jobs with support for pagination, sorting, and conditional filtering
description_zh: 获取任务列表，支持分页、排序和按条件过滤
kebab_example: aliyun pai-dlc list-jobs --display-name tf-mnist-test --job-type TFJob --status Running --start-time 2025-04-16T07:25:34Z --end-time 2025-04-16T07:26:41Z --page-number 1 --page-size 50 --sort-by GmtCreateTime --order desc --show-own true --workspace-id 10000 --resource-id r00000 --business-user-id 160000 --caller local --tags key=example-string --pipeline-id flow-0000000 --from-all-workspaces false --job-id dlc00000000 --user-id-for-filter 2000000000000000 --username test000 --resource-quota-name quota000 --accessibility PRIVATE --oversold-info ForbiddenQuotaOverSold --payment-type PostPaid --job-ids dlc123abc --display-name-search-mode wildcard --reason-search OOM --user-command-search python_train.py --image-search pytorch --time-range-field GmtFinishTime --numeric-range-field RequestGPU --numeric-range-min 4 --numeric-range-max 8 --enable-assign-node true --template-id tmlabc123 --description example-string --resource-ids example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListJobs

parameters.help_en:
The job name. Supports fuzzy match and is case-insensitive. Wildcards are not supported.
For example, entering test matches test-job1, job-test, job-test2, or job-Test, but does not match job-t1.
Default value: empty, which indicates all job names
parameters.help_zh:
任务名称，支持模糊查询，大小写不敏感，不支持通配符。
例如：输入test，可以匹配test-job1、job-test、job-test2或job-Test；但是不能匹配job-t1。
默认为空，代表任意任务名称
parameters.name: display_name

parameters.help_en:
The job type. Default value: empty, which indicates all types. Valid values:
TFJob
PyTorchJob
XGBoostJob
OneFlowJob
ElasticBatchJob
parameters.help_zh:
任务类型，默认为空，代表所有类型。支持的任务类型如下：
TFJob
PyTorchJob
XGBoostJob
OneFlowJob
ElasticBatchJob
parameters.name: job_type

parameters.help_en:
The job status. Valid values:
Creating
Queuing
Bidding (currently only for Lingjun Spot jobs)
EnvPreparing
SanityChecking
Running
Restarting
Stopping
SucceededReserving
FailedReserving
Succeeded
Failed
Stopped
parameters.help_zh:
任务运行状态，可能值：
Creating
Queuing
Bidding (当前仅限灵骏Spot作业)
EnvPreparing
SanityChecking
Running
Restarting
Stopping
SucceededReserving
FailedReserving
Succeeded
Failed
Stopped
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query range. The job creation time is used for filtering. Default value: the current time minus 7 days. If neither StartTime nor EndTime is specified, jobs created in the last 7 days are returned by default
parameters.help_zh: 查询区间的起始时间；使用任务的创建时间来过滤。默认值是当前时间减去7天，即：如果StartTime与EndTime都没有配置时，默认查询最近7天的任务列表
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query range. The job creation time is used for filtering. Default value: the current time
parameters.help_zh: 查询区间的截止时间；使用任务的创建时间来过滤。默认值是当前时刻
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The page number to return in a paged query. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 1. Paging starts from page 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询，指定当前需要返回的页码，起始值为1，默认为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of jobs to return per page
parameters.help_zh: 每页返回的任务数量
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The field by which to sort results. Valid values:

DisplayName
JobType
Status
GmtCreateTime
GmtFinishTime
parameters.help_zh:
排序字段：

DisplayName
JobType
Status
GmtCreateTime
GmtFinishTime
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en:
The sort order. Valid values:

desc: Descending order. This is the default value.
asc: Ascending order
parameters.help_zh:
排列顺序，支持：

desc：降序，默认值。
asc：升序
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to return only jobs submitted by the current user
parameters.help_zh: 是否只查询当前用户提交的任务列表
parameters.name: show_own

parameters.help_en: The workspace ID. <props="china">For information about how to obtain the workspace ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html.</props>
parameters.help_zh: 工作空间ID。<props="china">如何获取工作空间ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html。</props>
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The resource group ID. For information about how to obtain the dedicated resource group ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2651299.html
parameters.help_zh: 资源组ID。如何查询专有资源组ID，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2651299.html
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en: The user ID associated with the job
parameters.help_zh: 任务关联用户ID
parameters.name: business_user_id

parameters.help_en: The caller
parameters.help_zh: 调用方
parameters.name: caller

parameters.help_en: The tags used for filtering
parameters.help_zh: 用于过滤的标签
parameters.name: tags

parameters.help_en: Filters jobs created by the specified pipeline ID
parameters.help_zh: 过滤指定工作流ID创建的任务
parameters.name: pipeline_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to retrieve jobs across all workspaces. This parameter must be used together with `ShowOwn=true` to query jobs recently submitted by the current user
parameters.help_zh: 是否跨工作空间获取任务列表，需要配合`ShowOwn=true`参数使用，可以查询当前用户最近提交的任务列表
parameters.name: from_all_workspaces

parameters.help_en:
The job ID. Fuzzy match is not supported. Case-insensitive. Wildcards are not supported.
Default value: empty, which indicates all job IDs
parameters.help_zh:
任务ID，不支持模糊查询，对大小写不敏感。不支持通配符。
默认为空，代表任意任务ID
parameters.name: job_id

parameters.help_en: The user ID of the job submitter, used to filter the job list
parameters.help_zh: 按任务提交者的用户ID，过滤查询任务列表
parameters.name: user_id_for_filter

parameters.help_en: The username of the job submitter, used to filter the job list. Supports fuzzy match. Wildcards are not supported. Default value: empty, which indicates no filtering by username
parameters.help_zh: 按任务提交者的用户名，过滤查询任务列表。支持模糊查询，不支持通配符。默认为空，表示不过滤用户名
parameters.name: username

parameters.help_en: The name of the resource quota, used to filter the job list. Supports fuzzy match. Wildcards are not supported. Default value: empty, which indicates no filtering by resource quota
parameters.help_zh: 按资源配额的名字，过滤查询任务列表。支持模糊匹配，不支持通配符。默认为空，表示不过滤资源配额
parameters.name: resource_quota_name

parameters.help_en:
The visibility of the job. Valid values:
PUBLIC: Visible to all members in the workspace.
PRIVATE (default): Visible only to you and administrators in the workspace
parameters.help_zh:
作业的可见性，取值如下：
PUBLIC：在此工作空间中，对所有人可见。
PRIVATE（默认值）：在此工作空间中，仅对您和管理员可见
parameters.name: accessibility

parameters.help_en:
The off-peak resource information. Valid values:
ForbiddenQuotaOverSold
ForceQuotaOverSold
AcceptQuotaOverSold-true (true indicates the job actually used off-peak resources)
AcceptQuotaOverSold-false (false indicates the job actually used guaranteed resources)
parameters.help_zh:
闲时资源信息，可能的取值
ForbiddenQuotaOverSold
ForceQuotaOverSold
AcceptQuotaOverSold-true （true表示作业实际使用了闲时资源）
AcceptQuotaOverSold-false （false表示作业实际使用了保障资源）
parameters.name: oversold_info

parameters.help_en:
The resource type. Valid values:
PrePaid: resource quota.
Spot: preemptible resources.
PostPaid: public resources
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型，取值如下：
PrePaid：资源配额
Spot：竞价资源
PostPaid：公共资源
parameters.name: payment_type

parameters.help_en: A list of job IDs separated by commas. If both JobIds and JobId are specified, JobId takes precedence
parameters.help_zh: 任务ID列表，多个ID用英文逗号分隔。与JobId同时设置时，以JobId为准
parameters.name: job_ids

parameters.help_en: The search mode for DisplayName. Default value: wildcard match
parameters.help_zh: DisplayName搜索模式。默认为通配符匹配
parameters.name: display_name_search_mode

parameters.help_en: Uses full-text index to retrieve the node failed reason field. Supports Chinese and English tokenization
parameters.help_zh: 在任务失败原因(reason)字段中进行全文检索，支持中英文分词
parameters.name: reason_search

parameters.help_en: Uses full-text index to retrieve the user_command field. Supports Chinese and English tokenization
parameters.help_zh: 在用户命令(user_command)字段中进行全文检索，支持中英文分词
parameters.name: user_command_search

parameters.help_en: Uses full-text index to retrieve the images field. Supports Chinese and English tokenization
parameters.help_zh: 在镜像(images)字段中进行全文检索，支持中英文分词
parameters.name: image_search

parameters.help_en: The time field used for StartTime/EndTime filtering. Default value: creation time
parameters.help_zh: 指定StartTime/EndTime筛选使用的时间字段。不填默认为创建时间
parameters.name: time_range_field

parameters.help_en: The field name for numeric range filtering. Must be used together with NumericRangeMin or NumericRangeMax
parameters.help_zh: 数值范围筛选的字段名。需配合NumericRangeMin/NumericRangeMax使用
parameters.name: numeric_range_field

parameters.help_en: The minimum value (inclusive) for numeric range filtering. Must be used together with NumericRangeField
parameters.help_zh: 数值范围筛选的最小值（包含）。需配合NumericRangeField使用
parameters.name: numeric_range_min

parameters.help_en: The maximum value (inclusive) for numeric range filtering. Must be used together with NumericRangeField
parameters.help_zh: 数值范围筛选的最大值（包含）。需配合NumericRangeField使用
parameters.name: numeric_range_max

parameters.help_en: Filters jobs based on whether running on specified nodes is enabled
parameters.help_zh: 筛选是否启用指定节点运行的任务
parameters.name: enable_assign_node

parameters.help_en: The template ID, used to filter jobs created from the specified template
parameters.help_zh: 模板ID，用于筛选由指定模板创建的任务
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en: The Description
parameters.help_zh: The Description
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The ResourceIds
parameters.help_zh: The ResourceIds
parameters.name: resource_ids

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, used for diagnostics and troubleshooting

TotalCount.description_zh: 符合过滤条件的总任务数
